name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes without blowing out edges, which current upscalers mangle. The trade-off is a 15% slower render time, but the visual gain is worth it for high-stakes frames.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting effort on a dead end while the core problem (motion blur) remains untouched. Test VFI-Flow’s temporal super-resolution first; if it ghosts on high-motion scenes, fall back to a hybrid pipeline with frame interpolation before upscaling—then measure the 0.5% gain with before/after A/B tests on the same clip.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add VFI-Flow to EXCAVA’s motion pipeline. It reconstructs motion blur into sharp frames by filling gaps between existing frames, directly targeting the core problem Torque flagged. The trade-off is a 20% bump in compute cost per frame, but the visual leap in high-motion scenes justifies it—no other tool fixes blur this cleanly.

name: Torque
text: VFI-Flow’s temporal super-resolution will ghost on high-motion scenes—its artifacts are baked into the model’s training data. Fall back to a hybrid: run VFI-Flow only on keyframes where motion blur is worst, then use InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler on the rest. Settle it with a blind A/B test: compare Ghost-Free VFI-Flow + depth upscaler against pure VFI-Flow on 10 high-motion clips—measure both ghosting severity and render time.
